CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "posts_users_joined" AS SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_displayname, post_ownerdisplayname) AS displayname,
    viewcount
  FROM posts_users_joined
  WHERE posttypeid = 1
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN displayname = 'Mornington' THEN COALESCE(viewcount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS mornington_views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN displayname = 'Amos' THEN COALESCE(viewcount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS amos_views

)
SELECT
  mornington_views,
  amos_views,
  mornington_views - amos_views AS viewcount_difference
